title: Gas to Electric Hob Conversion in Batumi | Tech-Fix
heading: Gas to Electric Hob Conversion in Batumi
lead: Switch from gas to electric in one visit: gas panel removal, safe isolation, electric or induction hob installation and a wiring check. Batumi & Gonio.
description: Gas to electric hob conversion in Batumi: removal, safe gas isolation, electric or induction hob installation and a wiring check. Inspection 20 GEL.

sections.title: How the conversion works
items: Site visit and check: socket, cable cross-section and breaker — will your line handle the hob?
Gas isolation and removal of the old gas panel.
Tap sealed and joints leak-checked.
Electric or induction hob installed level.
Connection, test run and warranty on the install.

sections.title: What's included and what's not
items: Included: removal of the gas panel, tap isolation, new hob installation, connection and check.
Not included: the hob itself (you buy it separately — we help pick a compatible model).
A new line from the board, if the existing one is weak — quoted separately on site.
Official shutoff and sealing of the branch by the gas utility — we help you file the request.

sections.title: Check your wiring before buying the hob
items: Induction needs a dedicated line, a suitable breaker and the right cable cross-section.
We measure capacity and the line before you buy — don't overpay for a model your wiring can't run.
We'll advise whether induction or classic electric suits your setup.

sections.title: Gas safety and rules
items: Supply is closed at the tap, joints sealed and leak-checked.
Official branch shutoff and sealing is done by the gas utility — we help you file the request.
You can keep your gas oven: we only isolate the hob branch.

sections.title: Induction or classic electric
items: Induction is faster, more efficient and safer, but needs magnetic-base cookware.
Classic electric is cheaper and works with any pots.
We'll advise honestly for your wiring and budget.

sections.title: Timing
items: Most conversions take 1–2 hours.
Complex cases (transit pipe, a new line from the board) are quoted on site.
We work in Batumi and Gonio; same-day visits when a slot is free.

sections.title: Local conditions in Batumi
items: Humid climate and older housing stock: we check taps, joints and tightness.
If your line is fine, no new cable is needed — that keeps it cheaper.
Clear access to the hob and the meter before the visit — faster, with no extra dismantling.

price.title: Pricing
price.note: Final price after inspection, before work starts. You buy the hob separately — or we help pick a compatible model.

items.question: Do I need permission to disconnect the gas?
items.answer: Official branch shutoff and sealing is done by the gas utility. We remove the panel and seal the tap, and help you file the request.

items.question: Will my wiring handle an induction hob?
items.answer: We check capacity, cable and breaker before you buy. If the line is weak, we'll offer options.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Usually 1–2 hours. A new dedicated line is quoted separately.

items.question: Can I keep the gas oven?
items.answer: Yes. We only isolate the hob branch — the oven keeps working.
